speaker: bin
line: If this becomes a heroic speech, shoot me before the second paragraph.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: The snow feels different here. Like it is listening.
reply: Great. Even the weather has audience participation.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Check straps, check blades, and do not chase lights that whisper your name.
reply: I hate that this needed saying.

speaker: bin
line: Full party. The universe is going to overcompensate; brace yourselves.

speaker: bin
line: Half a party means twice the consequences. New math.

speaker: bin
line: New rule: if a ruin glows, we vote before touching it.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: Stay behind the line until I say otherwise.
reply: I adore being treated like expensive luggage.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: We should breathe for a moment. Everyone is pretending not to be tired.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Tracks stop here. That usually means a trap or wings.
reply: Please be wings. Wings are funnier.

speaker: bin
line: If we win, I am calling it strategy. If we lose, experimental theater.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: If they rush you, step left. I will make the right side regret itself.

speaker: haven_garr
line: You joke when you are scared. That is fine. Keep your feet moving too.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Stay close. I can patch one of you fast, not three.
reply: Noted. Doing my best to stay in patching range.

speaker: bin
line: A treasure cache. Finally, the universe remembers we are poor.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Some of this is still warm. That is either comforting or deeply bad.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: I will count it twice before we trust this is real money.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: Do not spend all the gold on weird trinkets.
reply: Define weird in a legally binding way.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Tents first, medicine second, toys last.
reply: The toys heard you and are devastated.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: We need salt, two new bandages, and one indulgent purchase. Morale matters.

speaker: bin
line: That stall has a suspicious amount of confidence for selling what is clearly a re-painted spoon.

speaker: bin
line: Jester Points are not money. They are consequences wearing a price tag.
reply: That explains the smell of destiny.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Peri's rewards always feel like they are smiling at us.
reply: That is because they know something.

speaker: haven_garr
line: If someone stays behind, it is a job, not a punishment.
reply: We will make the job sound heroic.

speaker: bin
line: Splitting the party is traditionally bad. So naturally, this system supports it.

speaker: bin
line: Squares. Finally, a battlefield honest enough to admit life is a board game.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: Corners matter. If you cannot see around one, assume teeth.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: I can feel safer paths under the frost. Not safe. Safer.

speaker: haven_garr
line: This is a clean way in. Mark the line for the way out.
reply: Marking it twice in case I forget the first one.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Something happened here that the snow has not finished forgetting.
reply: Then we ask politely before we touch anything.

speaker: bin
line: I have a brilliant plan. Step one: notice the obvious thing nobody is mentioning.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: Range. Now. Cover later.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Whatever you say next, do not say it heroically. Say it carefully.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Boots off. Hot drinks if we can. Shame if we cannot.
reply: Hot shame is also a drink.

speaker: bin
line: This place feels familiar in a way my memory refuses to sign for.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: If you make one smell joke, I am leaving you here.
reply: I have matured beyond the obvious joke. Mostly.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Wolves test the edge first. Do not give them one.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Old magic here is folded, like a letter someone never sent.

speaker: bin
line: Today I learned unconscious people are bad at teamwork.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: I can guard the supplies. Someone has to keep the hungry hero from selling the tent.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: If I stay with the wounded, bring back something warm.

speaker: haven_garr
line: I will mind the perimeter. Old men make excellent fences.
reply: You are the best fence we have.

speaker: bin
line: That is either the boss or a public monument to bad decisions.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Exit in sight. Do not relax until the door is behind us.

speaker: bin
line: The exit is where stories like to add one last surprise. Watch the corners.
reply: Watching the corners with both eyes.

speaker: bin
line: That has the energy of a story we will retell badly for years.

speaker: haven_garr
line: You are about to volunteer for something. Breathe first.
reply: I was going to say something witty.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: This place wants to be remembered. Let us not lie to it.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: I do not like clever puzzles in places where teeth happen.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Spend a Jester Point only if you can describe what you are buying.
reply: I am buying a feeling. Permission denied.

speaker: bin
line: That fight was so long it accidentally became a relationship.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: Wounds checked. Quiver counted. Lies later.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Sit. Drink. Stop being heroic for ten breaths.

speaker: bin
line: We are running on fumes and stubbornness. Mostly stubbornness.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: You are bleeding through three layers. Let me work.
reply: Work fast. Layer four is sentimental.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Danger is high. Do not invent more.

speaker: bin
line: At this danger level we get a complimentary monologue. Anyone want to volunteer?

speaker: bin
line: We have exactly enough gold to look poor with confidence.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: First watch is mine. Second watch is whoever owes me an apology.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Tea, then sleep. Sleep, then strategy. Strategy can wait until tea.

speaker: bin
line: Camp rule: if you start a story with 'I will be quick', you owe extra firewood.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Eat. Refit. Plan one move ahead. The forest plans three.
reply: I will plan two and a half.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Temples remember names. Use yours less in here.

speaker: bin
line: Bowy will say something dignified about smell soon. Witness it.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: Wolves listen. Walk soft. Talk softer.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Pups are not enemies. Mothers are. Let us be careful which we meet.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Wolves circle. We do not. Backs to each other.

speaker: bin
line: Bandits negotiate. Right up until the second they don't. Watch the second.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Sprites are mostly bluff. Aim for the bluff.

speaker: haven_garr
line: That is a thread. Pull it gently or do not pull it at all.

speaker: bin
line: Peri sent the oracle a haiku. Result is up there.
reply: Most haiku stay where they are.

speaker: haven_garr
line: Catch your breath now. The forest will not.

speaker: haven_mitia
line: Sit. Bandage. Confess only the small things.

speaker: haven_bowy
line: Real rest. Boots off. Bow restrung. Faces less broken.

speaker: bin
line: Time moves whether we ask it to or not. Rude, honestly.
